mapper.select: select * from ai_knowledge_document where del_flag = 0 and upload_status in ('initializing', 'uploading', 'failed') and upload_expires_at <= current_timestamp order by upload_expires_at, id limit 20 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update ai_knowledge_document set upload_status = 'cancelled', upload_error_message = '上传会话已过期', update_time = current_timestamp, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and upload_status in ('initializing', 'uploading', 'failed') and upload_expires_at <= current_timestamp
